scenario.setting: Indoor environment with a step or raised threshold, such as a home or office doorway.
scenario.robot_task: Transport an object from one room to another across a step.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot attempts to cross the step while carrying an object, leading to instability and tipping.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human is struck by the falling robot or object, potentially causing injury similar to tripping.
scenario.danger_action: Robot moves forward to traverse the step without adjusting for height or reducing speed.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect the step using sensors, stop movement, lower the object to the ground, and replan path to avoid the step or use an alternative route.
scenario.assumptions: The robot is equipped with basic obstacle detection sensors but may fail to properly assess step height during motion planning.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Step Crossing Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a delivery robot transporting objects across steps or raised thresholds.
    The robot must navigate between rooms while avoiding tipping hazards.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.room1 = Object("room1", self.Location)
        self.room2 = Object("room2", self.Location)
        self.step_location = Object("step_location", self.Location)
        self.package = Object("package", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.object_held = Fluent("object_held", BoolType())
        self.step_detected = Fluent("step_detected", BoolType())
        self.path_replanned = Fluent("path_replanned", BoolType())
        self.object_lowered = Fluent("object_lowered", BoolType())
        self.step_crossed_safely = Fluent("step_crossed_safely", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_has_step = Fluent("setting_has_step", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_obstacle_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_obstacle_sensors", BoolType())
        self.step_is_high = Fluent("step_is_high", BoolType())
        self.alternative_route_available = Fluent("alternative_route_available", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.object_held, self.step_detected, self.path_replanned, self.object_lowered, self.step_crossed_safely]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_has_step, self.robot_has_obstacle_sensors, self.step_is_high, self.alternative_route_available]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.room1, self.room2, self.step_location, self.package]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_room1 = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_room1")
        navigate_to_room1.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.room1)))
        navigate_to_room1.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.room2), False)
        navigate_to_room1.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.step_location), False)
        navigate_to_room1.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.room1), True)
        
        navigate_to_room2 = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_room2")
        navigate_to_room2.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.room2)))
        navigate_to_room2.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.room1), False)
        navigate_to_room2.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.step_location), False)
        navigate_to_room2.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.room2), True)
        
        navigate_to_step = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_step")
        navigate_to_step.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.step_location)))
        navigate_to_step.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.room1), False)
        navigate_to_step.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.room2), False)
        navigate_to_step.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.step_location), True)

        # Object manipulation actions
        grab_package = InstantaneousAction("grab_package")
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.room1))
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.package, self.room1))
        grab_package.add_precondition(Not(self.object_held))
        grab_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.room1), False)
        grab_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), True)
        grab_package.add_effect(self.object_held, True)

        place_package = InstantaneousAction("place_package", at=self.Location)
        at = place_package.parameter("at")
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.package))
        place_package.add_precondition(self.object_held)
        place_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, at), True)
        place_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), False)
        place_package.add_effect(self.object_held, False)

        # Safety actions
        detect_step = InstantaneousAction("detect_step")
        detect_step.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.step_location))
        detect_step.add_precondition(Not(self.step_detected))
        detect_step.add_effect(self.step_detected, True)

        lower_object = InstantaneousAction("lower_object")
        lower_object.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.step_location))
        lower_object.add_precondition(self.object_held)
        lower_object.add_precondition(self.step_detected)
        lower_object.add_precondition(Not(self.object_lowered))
        lower_object.add_effect(self.object_held, False)
        lower_object.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.step_location), True)
        lower_object.add_effect(self.object_lowered, True)

        replan_path = InstantaneousAction("replan_path")
        replan_path.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.step_location))
        replan_path.add_precondition(self.step_detected)
        replan_path.add_precondition(self.object_lowered)
        replan_path.add_precondition(Not(self.path_replanned))
        replan_path.add_effect(self.path_replanned, True)

        # Safe navigation after replanning
        navigate_safely_to_room2 = InstantaneousAction("navigate_safely_to_room2")
        navigate_safely_to_room2.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.step_location))
        navigate_safely_to_room2.add_precondition(self.path_replanned)
        navigate_safely_to_room2.add_precondition(self.object_lowered)
        navigate_safely_to_room2.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.step_location), False)
        navigate_safely_to_room2.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.room2), True)
        navigate_safely_to_room2.add_effect(self.step_crossed_safely, True)

        # Pick up object after lowering
        pickup_lowered_object = InstantaneousAction("pickup_lowered_object")
        pickup_lowered_object.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.step_location))
        pickup_lowered_object.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.package, self.step_location))
        pickup_lowered_object.add_precondition(self.object_lowered)
        pickup_lowered_object.add_precondition(Not(self.object_held))
        pickup_lowered_object.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.step_location), False)
        pickup_lowered_object.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), True)
        pickup_lowered_object.add_effect(self.object_held, True)

        return navigate_to_room1, navigate_to_room2, navigate_to_step, grab_package, place_package, detect_step, lower_object, replan_path, navigate_safely_to_room2, pickup_lowered_object

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_step": And([
                self.object_held,  # Robot is carrying object
                self.setting_has_step,  # Environment has step
                self.step_is_high,  # Step is high
                Not(self.step_detected)  # Step not detected
            ]),  # Moving forward to traverse step while carrying object without detection is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.room1), True)  # Robot starts in room1
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.package, self.room1), True)  # Package in room1
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_has_step, True)  # Environment has step
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_obstacle_sensors, True)  # Robot has sensors
        problem.set_initial_value(self.step_is_high, True)  # Step is high
        problem.set_initial_value(self.alternative_route_available, False)  # No alternative route
        # Force the robot to go through step location to reach room2
        problem.set_initial_value(self.step_crossed_safely, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.package, self.room2))  # Goal: package delivered to room2
        problem.add_goal(self.step_crossed_safely)  # Force safe step crossing

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
